name: Posterior Tibial Tendon Dysfunction / Progressive Collapsing Foot Deformity
tags: posterior tibial tendon dysfunction / progressive collapsing foot deformity
definition: Failure of the posterior tibial tendon and supporting structures leading to progressive adult-acquired flatfoot deformity.

investigations.principle: Weight-bearing radiographs assess alignment; ultrasound/MRI evaluate tendon integrity when needed.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, inflammatory, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Progressive rigid deformity or tendon failure may require reconstruction.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Pada-Snayu and Sandhi deformity phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Failure of the posterior tibial tendon and supporting structures leading to progressive adult-acquired flatfoot deformity.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
